findings.evidence: The proofs use these assumptions to compose `Measure.map`; Mathlib provides `AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable`, and the neighboring `map_prefixProj_pathLaw` and `map_pathLaw` in `Exchangeability/Basic.lean:174,204` expose `AEMeasurable` hypotheses. Line 153 already passes `hν.aemeasurable` to `bind_map`, confirming pointwise measurability is unnecessary there.
findings.fix: Replace the standalone `hν`/`hX` hypotheses with `AEMeasurable ν μ` and `∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ`; make the final theorem accept the latter and use `AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable`.
findings.issue: `map_fst_jointPathLaw`, `map_snd_jointPathLaw`, `map_prefixPair_jointPathLaw`, `map_prefixPair_iidMixtureLaw`, and especially `ConditionallyIIDWith.jointPathLaw_eq_iidMixtureLaw` impose `Measurable` hypotheses although their map-composition arguments only need `AEMeasurable` relative to `μ`.

summary: Several new APIs require pointwise measurability where the natural measure-theoretic hypothesis is almost-everywhere measurability.
